purpose: Review of P-0003 claim 'separated by 3.0 to 6.0 along a line': orientation test. A-A at rest, sep 4 along the diagonal from (3,3) to (3+d,3+d), d=4/sqrt(2), T=2. P-0003 was fit only to horizontal pairs. Prediction: central, equal-magnitude force, so the pair moves along the diagonal with the same K/r^2.5 law. Falsified if the relative separation-time curve departs from the predictor by more than 0.15 on average per coordinate.
